title: Fitness-beats-truth theorem in evolutionary game theory

tellings.quote: In in fact, what we discovered is the probability is zero that any sensory system has ever been shaped to see any true feature of objective reality.

plain: A scientist named Don Hoffman says that he and his colleagues proved a theorem showing that evolution rewards usefulness, not accuracy: in his words, "the probability is zero that any sensory system has ever been shaped to see any true feature of objective reality." He tells it as his own research, built on evolutionary game theory, the mathematics of how strategies compete for survival, which goes back to Darwin and the biologist John Maynard Smith. If he is right, our senses show us a convenient interface rather than the world as it is, and things that are really there, aliens included, could go unseen.
